chapter: Chicago and Oliver's band in California
title: Closing: ride to the jam session and release paper
summary: The interviewer offers a cab to the jam session and raises the release form with a no-commercial-use line.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: Oh. I know you want to get to that jam session. I hate to cut you off in the middle, but if you want, I can ride you down there in a cab. Would that be nice? You see?
That's all right. I thought it was only one block. Oh, no, man.

It's about three or four blocks. We're in the 300 block and it's at the end of the 600 and you've got to go around the corners. It's about three and a half blocks. Oh. So if you can give me a minute to put this stuff up. I sure appreciate your talking. I'll get you to sign that paper and sign your life away, but your lawyer will take care of that over there, huh? Okay?
I don't know. I made my mind up yet. Okay, well she can read it to you and tell you.
I think we ought to put on there no commercial use, okay? Yeah. Without permission of him. Right. Okay? Good line. Good line.
